text:
emily.marketing: Hey runtime team — prepping the press deck + webinar narrative for next week. Need a tiny sanity sweep to validate headline bench numbers for the 13B and 70B variants (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k). Also need a way to map traces to inbound lead buckets (webinar signups vs organic). Can you share a checklist and ETA? :rocket:

jordan.runtime: We can run a micro-sweep. Quick: which flavors (fp16 vs 4-bit)? include coldstart? coldstart affects p95 a lot.

emily.marketing: Use the variants we plan to cite: 13B-4bit and 70B-fp16. Please run coldstart and warmed separately. Tiny cohort ok (100 requests). Capture traces + request headers so we can join to CRM. Deadline ~24h.

sam.eng: I’ll spin up 100 requests on staging pools. Plan: warmup=10, batch=auto, seq_len=512. ETA ~6h. Will produce: raw traces, latency histogram, tokens/sec, sample payloads.

nina.marketing: For lead routing, we need a stable header to detect later. Suggest `X-RT-Route: webinar-apr`. Can that be stamped in traces?

jordan.runtime: Yes — bench client can set `X-RT-Route` and we’ll include it in trace metadata. Also add `bench_run_id` for joins. Example: 
```
./tools/run_bench --model 13B-4bit --requests 100 --warmup 10 --header "X-RT-Route:webinar-apr" --out-dir /tmp/bench-1812349001
```

sam.eng: queued job. benchbot: PENDING.

benchbot: Job queued: bench-1812349001 (owner: sam.eng). Est runtime: 00:18:00.

sam.eng: 13B-4bit first pass done. Quick metrics: warmed p50=42ms, p95=210ms; coldstart p95=480ms. Throughput ~800 toks/sec on T4-equivalent. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-dev/bench/1812349001/13b-4bit/

emily.marketing: Can you include a small CSV mapping bench_run_id -> X-RT-Route and a sample of 10 traces with headers visible? Analytics needs those for lead scoring.

sam.eng: attaching CSV + sample traces. Running 70B-fp16 now.

jordan.runtime: Note cost-per-1k is estimate-only (instance pricing + token rates). Sam — include the cost script, runtime version, and commit hash for reproducibility.

sam.eng: added runtime: v2.3.1, commit: 8f7b2a, cost script invocation in out-dir.

ella.sales: FYI — if you see header `X-RT-Route:webinar-apr` after launch, route those leads into webinar follow-up queue. Mapping: hot if response <1min, warm otherwise.

nina.marketing: Confirmed. Webinar header + signup form => priority=hot. We'll share final mapping.

sam.eng: 70B-fp16 done. Warmed p50=120ms, p95=450ms; coldstart p95=980ms; throughput ~2200 toks/sec. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-dev/bench/1812349001/70b-fp16/

sam.eng: uploaded: metrics.json, latency_hist.csv, sample_traces.tar.gz, bench_run_map.csv, run_cmd.txt. bench_run_map.csv columns: bench_run_id, model, header_tag, run_time, commit.

emily.marketing: Can you also run a tiny mixed rerun (50% webinar header, 50% organic) to confirm header propagation under small concurrency for the live demo?

jordan.runtime: Will do a 200-request mixed run with concurrency=4 and include trace join keys.

sam.eng: scheduled mixed run.

benchbot: Job started: bench-1812349001-mixed (owner: sam.eng). ETA 00:25:00.

sam.eng: mixed run done. Verified `X-RT-Route` present in 100% of traces where included; bench_run_map.csv updated. No sampling loss at concurrency=4.

emily.marketing: Please drop S3 links and a one-paragraph summary for the press slide (one line per model: p50/p95/cost estimate).

sam.eng: S3 links above. Summary line: 13B-4bit (warmed) p50=42ms p95=210ms cost≈$0.12/1k tokens; 70B-fp16 (warmed) p50=120ms p95=450ms cost≈$0.52/1k tokens. All runs include bench_run_id and X-RT-Route where requested.

jordan.runtime: Confirmed runtime version + commit included in each out-dir.

emily.marketing: Perfect — preparing the slide. Tagging you for review. If anything pops up in 24h ping here. :tada:

ella.sales: Ping me when final CSV is in place so I can wire CRM mapping.

emily.marketing: Will do. Thanks all!
